Automated sorting of post-consumer textiles

Grant agreement ID
999000002
Start date
1 June 2020
End date
31 May 2024
Funded under
H2020-EU.3.5.4.

Objective

SORTWISE combines near-infrared spectroscopy and image recognition to sort used textiles by fibre and colour at industrial speed, so that sorted fractions can feed fibre-to-fibre recycling. Pilot lines in two sorting centres measure purity, throughput and the share of each fraction that finds a recycler.
